_comment: Event dates (attributes.event_date and the date in each title) are shifted forward by whole weeks at load time, relative to dates_anchored_to (shift_event_dates in api/mock_ticketing.py); merchant_pacing.json and the order lines that name these shows shift with them. Author the dates as if dates_anchored_to were today.

products.title: The Headliner — Summer Tour · Fri Aug 14 · GA Pit
products.short_description: Standing GA pit at the rail for the Friday ACME Amphitheater show. Price is all-in.
products.long_description: The Summer Tour closes its summer leg with two nights at ACME Amphitheater. The GA pit is standing room directly in front of the stage with its own entrance and rail access on both sides. Doors 18:00, support act 19:30, headline 20:30. All prices shown are all-in: face value plus all fees, itemized before checkout.

specs.age_policy: all ages; under 16 with an adult

review_highlights: The pit rail at ACME Amphitheater is the best view in the venue — the stage sits low.
Security walks the pit with water on hot nights; re-entry to the pit is wristbanded.
